name: @amaral.codes/content-sync
description: Synchronize public Notion entries and projects into an ignored build-time Markdown snapshot for amaral.codes

scripts.quality:crap: crap-typescript --package-manager npm --test-runner vitest --threshold 6 --format json --output coverage/crap.json src && node ../../scripts/commands/assert-crap-report.mjs coverage/crap.json
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test -- --coverage && npm run quality:crap
